vip_retention.evidence: VIPs are 27.8% of customers and generate 63.4% of adjusted revenue; mean frequency is 6.0 orders.
vip_retention.action: Offer tiered early access and service benefits to VIP customers.
vip_retention.expected_effect: Protect revenue concentration and improve repeat purchase rate.
vip_retention.validation_data: Campaign/control repeat-purchase rate, gross margin, benefit cost, and 90-day churn.

churn_reactivation.evidence: Churned customers are 50.0% of customers with mean recency 179.5 days.
churn_reactivation.action: Run a randomized reactivation test with a time-limited incentive.
churn_reactivation.expected_effect: Recover dormant customers without discounting the entire base.
churn_reactivation.validation_data: Holdout reactivation, incremental revenue, contribution margin, unsubscribe rate, and churn-reason survey.

new_customer_onboarding.evidence: The New segment contains 531 customers (16.3%) and median frequency 1.
new_customer_onboarding.action: Trigger product education and a second-order recommendation within 14 days.
new_customer_onboarding.expected_effect: Increase conversion from first purchase to the second order.
new_customer_onboarding.validation_data: 14/30-day second-order rate, recommendation click-through, returns, and cohort retention.
